name: The Group's software is one platformized operating system, repaired by fixing its tools
asks: Leader utterances of 2026-08-26 to 2026-09-26 (pass general-1): the codebase is one operating system, not three thousand; every leaf is configuration over upstream; broken tools are fixed and never bypassed; slow tests are bad tests; early alpha carries no backward compatibility; legacy is consolidated, never mass-deleted; no TypeScript or external dependencies; scripts/ not bin/.

x-provenance.recorded-by: general-1 pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Leader utterances of 2026-08-26 to 2026-09-26 (pass general-1): the codebase is one operating system, not three thousand; every leaf is configuration over upstream; broken tools are fixed and never bypassed; slow tests are bad tests; early alpha carries no backward compatibility; legacy is consolidated, never mass-deleted; no TypeScript or external dependencies; scripts/ not bin/.

requirements.says: The Group's software ecosystem shall be one operating system whose applications are modules of the computer system engine.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 17:40-17:43: "ONE OPERATING SYSTEM, NOT 3000, not zero"; "modules for computer-system-engine ... an actual coherent codebase"; Plan 9 cannot run Linux software because the software is written wrong for the platform.

requirements.says: The computer system engine shall realize the data, code and networking layers as parts of one engine, with no separate package for each layer.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 17:43: computer-data-engine, compute-code-engine and computer-networking-engine "all those three to computer-system-engine"; 2026-09-23 02:23: "there isn't meant to be a computer-code-engine, same for the other things".

requirements.says: Each leaf package of the ecosystem shall consist of configuration variables over upstream shared code.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 14:57: "A COUPLE CONFIG VARIABLES OVER UPSTREAM STUFF ... TAKE THE FUNCTION AND MOVE IT UPSTREAM".

requirements.says: The durable tooling of each owning engineering section shall be repaired where found broken, so that a session cannot complete its work by bypassing the tool.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 15:55: "ALWAYS FIX THE TOOL, INVEST DONT SPEND"; 18:19: "fix it so that future sessions cannot not use the tool".

requirements.says: The code-transformation toolchain shall provide semantic and syntactic deduplication in addition to AST codemods.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 20:54: "CODEMOD, SEMANTIC DEDUPLICATION, SYNTACTIC DEDUPLICATION. IMPROVE OUR CODEMOD TOOLING ... LIKE IT IS 2026 not 1992 'let me grep for keyword'".

requirements.says: The Group's test suites shall complete fast enough that no session waits on them, a slow test being treated as a defect of the test.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 21:23: "always assume slow tests are indicative of bad tests, that should be our engineering SOP".

requirements.says: The Group's software shall carry no backward-compatibility shim, wrapper or consumer-preserving layer while the codebase is early alpha.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 18:09: "FUCK THE CONSUMERS, FIX THEM NEXT"; 2026-09-24 15:52: "maintaining all backcompat, shims ... in this early alpha codebase, that is inappropriate".

requirements.says: The consolidation procedure shall merge each legacy codebase into one living location, retaining its capabilities, deleting nothing unchecked and leaving no empty directory.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-23 03:43: "we are not looking to delete things in legacy ... consolidating the code into singular living locations ... mass deletions, mass moves, are never it"; 2026-09-10 04:06: "DO NOT LEAVE EMPTY DIRECTORYS"; 2026-09-22 17:26: one copy of pyfars.

requirements.says: The Group's software shall use no TypeScript and no external dependency.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-21 00:43: "we are literally not supposed to use typescript OR have external dependencies".

requirements.says: The Group's software shall hold every executable file under a directory named scripts, with no bin directory.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-08-27 17:25: "No bin/, just scripts/ ... the directory for 'these are files you run'".

requirements.says: The command-line help of each operation shall be derived from its typed operation description or JSDoc, and argument parsing shall be one script in the JavaScript engineering section.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 23:03 and 23:16: "why is --help not read from JSDoc ... where is our typed 'operation'"; one scripts/parse-argv.mjs in javascript-engineering-services-section.

requirements.says: The agent guidance projection shall stay within a stated per-turn size, the Group treating 58 kB of rules injected each turn as a budget emergency.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 21:59: "58kb OF RULES INJECTED EVERY TURN THAT IS A FUCKING BUDGET EMERGENCY".

requirements.says: The agent hooks shall carry no tool ban and no injected prose, and their logic shall live in the owning engineering section.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 18:14-18:16 and 2026-09-11 17:52: hooks banning typedoc and the comment-ratio hook cost about $50 a day; "REMOVE ALL PROSE HOOK INJECTION".

requirements.says: The agent platform shall hand a session to another session by session identifier, giving the receiving session the whole prior transcript including the part before compaction.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 19:50-19:55 and 2026-09-22 15:22: "how do we hand off this session to another? we don't even have tooling for THAT"; "READ ALL THE PROSE IN THE TRANSCRIPT".

requirements.says: The transcript tooling shall make the Leader's prompts of prior sessions cheap to mine.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 18:04: "Figure it out from transcripts. Make it cheaper to figure shit out from transcripts."

requirements.says: The agent platform shall report why each agent stopped.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 18:54: "What is stopping your agents? did you never check?"

requirements.says: The git engine of the agent platform shall perform the commit, push and move of a session's changes as one durable operation, so that no agent runs git or npm by hand.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 04:54 and 2026-09-11 19:29: all of a session's moves in "one fucking commit"; "some git-engine that's loaded into some agent-platform running here on this machine".

requirements.says: The persistent machine server shall be the single control plane through which every agent interaction with the machine passes.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 22:34: "all interaction with the machine should go through that server ... a centralized unix control plane"; 22:36: a server limit that removes the agents' ability to repair the server is not set.

requirements.says: The Group's agent operating policy shall treat a divergence as drift unless evidence shows it to be intended, and shall not accept a comment, README or earlier agent's statement as that evidence.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 13:12, 17:23, 20:40: "AI trying to excuse being lazy by saying 'deliberate'"; 2026-09-21 03:31: "This assumes the callers are correct in calling it. STOP DOING THAT."
